items.title: Academic biography
items.description: I am a researcher trained in public health, medical big data, epidemiology and human nutrition. My research investigates how lifestyle behaviours, existing health conditions and socioeconomic factors influence mortality, healthy ageing and opportunities for prevention. I have analysed longitudinal data from the Korean Genome and Epidemiology Study (KoGES-HEXA) and worked in community nutrition and public health programming in Uganda.
